text: Hey team, quick question — what auth method does the API use now? I still have old docs saying API keys.
We migrated to OAuth 2.0 with JWT tokens in v2. API keys are gone. Make sure you're using the v2 base URL: https://api.acme.io/v2
Got it! And what's the rate limit for the Pro tier?
Pro tier is 1,000 req/min with a burst of 5,000 requests in 30 seconds. Enterprise is 10k/min with custom burst. The old 50 req/min limit was v1 only.
Are PDFs supported for document upload? The v1 docs say no.
Yes! v2 supports PDF, Markdown, HTML, and plain text. The Document Service uses Docling for PDF extraction.
Reminder: all services must validate JWT signatures using the Keycloak JWKS endpoint. Do NOT do local key validation.
Confirmed, we're hitting https://auth.acme.io/realms/acme/protocol/openid-connect/certs for all validation.
How long are documents retained? A customer asked.
7 years by default for compliance. v1 was 30 days but that's deprecated. Customers can configure shorter retention in workspace settings if needed.
